name: Dumbbell lateral raise
notes: Standing shoulder isolation. Record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Stand with dumbbells at the sides, a soft bend in the elbows, and a tall chest without arching the lower back.
guide.execution: Raise the arms out and slightly forward to near shoulder height, then lower slowly.
guide.cues: Lead with the elbows. Keep shoulders away from the ears. Use a smooth arc.
guide.mistakes: Shrugging; swinging the torso; lifting too high; using weights that force a bent elbow.
